CONFIRMED_FROM_CURRENT_RUNTIME: Death and manual retreat both use the operator's effective redeploy time, including redeploy_time_delta.
At removal time the tile and blocked enemies are released; manual retreat refunds half the deployment cost, while death refunds zero.
A later explicit DEPLOY is required; HP, SP, skill state and a fresh deployment cost begin from phase data. Skills issued while dead or undeployed are invalid.
Static checking cannot know when death occurs. A duplicate DEPLOY without an earlier RETREAT must be treated as conditional redeployment, then verified by simulation.
survival_and_redeployment_facts.V4_COUNTEREXAMPLE: Gallus withdrew at frame3120; its 200 s cooldown was not complete at frame5223, so the static and runtime rejection is correct.
UNKNOWN: No physical-dodge runtime is currently implemented; physical damage type alone does not establish artillery dodge.
Damage shields and probability-triggered survival are not current-model facts and remain UNKNOWN unless runtime support is demonstrated.
